Supply no more than 30-dollars across 2 positions for one week, using a stable pair and spreading activity over at least 3 sessions.
Complete Hakutora's core Risk Curators action twice per week for 4 weeks, recording transaction hashes and its $16.2M TVL baseline; current change is +2.7% over 7d.
Use 10-dollars per session to test deposits, swaps or claims, and set a 3 percent loss limit so failed incentives do not exceed the weekly budget.
Check official Discord, X and governance channels every 7 days for incentive, snapshot or eligibility rules; preserve proof of activity and use a hardware wallet for larger sums.
After 30 days, withdraw all test positions, review the net result, and only continue with a 25-dollar cap until a real token allocation or official claim is confirmed.
